items.text: Ladd McConkey (back) downgraded to out for Week 10
Chargers WR Ladd McConkey will not travel to Baltimore with the team and he has been ruled out for MNF.
Geno Smith being evaluated for a concussion
A.J. Brown (NE WR) status questionable -> out [Hamstring]
Drake Maye (NE QB) status healthy -> out [Ankle]
And now: Patriots WR A.J. Brown has a hamstring injury and is questionable to return.

Jets WR Garrett Wilson (concussion) cleared the NFL’s concussion protocol and will play today. Meanwhile, WR Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle) and AD Mitchell (knee) are both expected to go after being listed as questionable.

Vikings WR Jordan Addison, who suffered a thumb injury in practice on Friday and is questionable, will have his status determined closed to game-time. But there is some doubt, as MIN elevated WR Jeshaun Jones as insurance.
